how_to_apply: Appear for the walk-in interview on 30-11-2026 at 11.00 am at the Seminar Room, Dept. of Physics, 4th Floor, New Technology Building, IIEST, Shibpur.
Bring two hard copies of the bio-data to submit, with original mark sheet and certificate.
A soft copy of the bio-data may be sent in advance by e-mail to Dr. Abhijit Bisoi at [email protected].
The application must mention a valid e-mail id and phone number.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIEST Shibpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Seminar Room, Dept. of Physics, 4th Floor, New Technology Building, IIEST, Shibpur.

faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Pay Rs. 35000 per month with no other allowances.

faq.answer: Duration 3 years, up to May 2029 or till the project continues, whichever is earlier. The position is purely temporary.
